    • build

      static ReportData build(List<SimulationRecord> records, CombatSimulator sim, List<StatsSnapshot> statsHistory)
      Builds the ReportData bundle that drives HTML rendering.
      パラメータ:
      records - raw simulation records (may be null)
      sim - combat simulator that produced the records (may be null)
      statsHistory - optional analysis stat snapshots; null disables the timeline slider in the report
      戻り値:
      populated report data

    • cumulativeDamageSeries

      private static Map<String, List<String>> cumulativeDamageSeries(List<SimulationRecord> records, Map<String,Double> totalDamageByActor, double endTime)
      Builds per-actor cumulative damage series as JS object literal strings.
      パラメータ:
      records - simulation records ordered by time
      totalDamageByActor - totals keyed by actor name (defines the series set)
      endTime - timestamp appended as the final point of every series
      戻り値:
      series points keyed by actor display name

    • artifactRolls

      private static List<ReportData.ReportArtifactRollView> artifactRolls(CombatSimulator sim)
      Collects artifact substat roll views for every party member.
      パラメータ:
      sim - combat simulator; may be null
      戻り値:
      per-character roll views, or an empty list when sim is null
